const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"/tmp/pumpmodem-cleanup-venv/bin/python -B - <<'PY'
import sys
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/delegation-recovery-runs/v517/workspace/tools')
from triad_dynamic_joint import BlockProjection
p = BlockProjection.make(64, 64.0, ((0.0, 0.0),), ())
assert p.indices.tolist() == [0]
rng = np.random.default_rng(817)
for dtype in (np.float16, np.float32, np.float64, np.longdouble,
              np.complex64, np.complex128, np.clongdouble,
              np.int8, np.int16, np.int32, np.int64, np.uint8, np.bool_):
    raw = rng.normal(size=(2, 3, 64))
    if np.dtype(dtype).kind == 'c':
        raw = raw + 1j * rng.normal(size=raw.shape)
    x = np.asarray(raw, dtype=dtype)
    got, expected = p.numpy(x), np.fft.fft(x, axis=-1, norm='ortho')[..., p.indices]
    assert got.shape == expected.shape == (2, 3, 1), (dtype, got.shape)
    assert got.dtype == expected.dtype, (dtype, got.dtype, expected.dtype)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(got, expected, rtol=2e-6, atol=2e-6, equal_nan=True)
# Empty leading dimensions and legacy failure paths.
assert p.numpy(np.empty((0, 64), dtype=np.complex64)).shape == (0, 1)
for x in (np.zeros(63), np.array(1.0)):
    try: p.numpy(x)
    except (ValueError, IndexError): pass
    else: raise AssertionError('expected legacy shape failure')
try: p.numpy(np.array(['a'] * 64))
except (TypeError, ValueError): pass
else: raise AssertionError('expected legacy nonnumeric dtype failure')
print('PASS: singleton DC equivalence across 13 dtypes; shape, dtype, empty batch, and errors')
PY",yield_time_ms:30000,max_output_tokens:2000});
text(r.output);
